import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long mod;
    static long x;
    static long[] fact;
    static long[] dp;
    static long[] tree;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        mod = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        x = euler_func(mod);
        fact = new long[n + 5];
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n + 4; i++) {
            fact[i] = (i * fact[i - 1]) % mod;
        }
        if (n <= 3) {
            System.out.println(0);
        } else {
            dp = new long[2000];
            dp[0] = 1;
            dp[1] = 2;
            dp[2] = 2;
            dp[3] = 1;
            tree = new long[2005];
            make_tree(2005);
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                update(i, dp[i]);
            }
            long m = 3;
            long ans = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 3; i++) {
                long[] dp0 = Arrays.copyOf(dp, dp.length);
                long ans0 = 0;
                for (int j = i + 3; j < 2000; j++) {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= m + 1; k++) {
                        ans0 += get_sum(j + k, 2004) * dp0[k - 1] % mod;
                        ans0 %= mod;
                        dp[j] += dp0[k - 1];
                        dp[j] %= mod;
                        update(j, dp[j]);
                    }
                }
                m += i + 3;
                ans += f(i + 4, n) * ans0 % mod;
                ans %= mod;
            }
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
    }

    static long euler_func(long n) {
        Set<Long> p = new HashSet<>();
        for (long i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
            while (n % i == 0) {
                p.add(i);
                n /= i;
            }
        }
        if (n != 1) {
            p.add(n);
        }
        long x = n;
        for (long i : p) {
            x *= (i - 1);
            x /= i;
        }
        return x;
    }

    static long f(long a, long b) {
        long ans = 1;
        for (long i = a + 1; i <= b; i++) {
            ans *= i;
            ans %= mod;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static void make_tree(int n) {
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            if (i >= n * 2) {
                tree = new long[i];
                break;
            } else {
                i *= 2;
            }
        }
    }

    static void update(int i, long x) {
        i += tree.length / 2;
        tree[i] = x;
        i /= 2;
        while (true) {
            if (i == 0) {
                break;
            }
            tree[i] = tree[2 * i] + tree[2 * i + 1];
            i /= 2;
        }
    }

    static long get_sum(int s, int t) {
        s += tree.length / 2;
        t += tree.length / 2;
        long ans = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (s > t) {
                break;
            }
            if (s % 2 == 0) {
                s /= 2;
            } else {
                ans += tree[s];
                s = (s + 1) / 2;
            }
            if (t % 2 == 1) {
                t /= 2;
            } else {
                ans += tree[t];
                t = (t - 1) / 2;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
}
